criteria.description: Correctly classifies all three (force, task, motion respectively).

solutions.fullSolution: (a) Force-level (raw force specified directly). (b) Task-level (symbolic action/skill, abstracts away how). (c) Motion-level (kinematic trajectory specified).

criteria.description: Correctly explains continuity as no teleporting between pick and place.
Correctly explains the entry point as the achieved grasp determining the place problem's feasible space.

solutions.fullSolution: Continuity: the place motion must start exactly where the pick motion ended, no teleporting, the robot's configuration is continuous across the mode switch. Entry point: the feasible space for placing (which depends on how the cup is held) is determined by exactly where/how the pick motion ended, not chosen independently; the achieved grasp becomes a parameter of the place problem.

phi-bar: 'while grasped, the object's pose is rigidly fixed relative to the gripper,' holding at every instant during the mode. phi-hat: 'at the moment of grasping, the fingers must be at the object's surface, correctly aligned,' checked only at the single mode-switch instant.

criteria.description: Correctly identifies simulation trial-and-error data as the privileged source.
Correctly identifies that deployment only sees images, matching RLEARN-06's pattern.

solutions.fullSolution: Training labels come from trial-and-error data in simulation, with privileged access to exact shapes/poses/physics, same source as RLEARN-06's ACRONYM. At deployment, phi_theta only sees camera images I, never exact shapes/poses. Same pattern: a privileged simulator generates labels, the network reproduces the judgment from realistic image input, now supplying a full constraint function for the LGP.

criteria.description: Correctly maps g,S to the fixed context/prompt.

solutions.fullSolution: a_k corresponds to the next token, a_{1:k-1} to the previous tokens. g and S (goal and scene) correspond to the fixed context/prompt held throughout the sequence. So pi(a_k|g,a_{1:k-1},S) is exactly 'predict the next token given previous tokens and fixed context,' the same autoregressive structure as a language model, with symbolic actions instead of words.
